title: LESCC Financial Channeling Mechanisms for NYC Parks
objective: Establish direct, reliable revenue flows from Lower East Side commercial growth to NYC Parks license fees

channeling_mechanisms.name: Direct Coalition Fee Guarantee
channeling_mechanisms.description: Surrounding merchants, property owners, and cultural institutions pledge a percentage of increased revenue generated by park foot traffic directly to LESCC's payment fund.

parks_bid_requirements.minimum_annual_license_fee: Guaranteed via aggregated merchant pledge commitments.
parks_bid_requirements.security_deposit: Covers required 25% of highest year's fee.

channeling_mechanisms.implementation_method: Signed pledge letters attached directly to bid submission without requiring a new legal entity upfront.

channeling_mechanisms.name: Lower East Side BID Backstop
channeling_mechanisms.partner_entity: Lower East Side Business Improvement District (LES BID)
channeling_mechanisms.assessment_structure: Mandatory assessment on property owners within BID boundaries, eliminating free-riders.
channeling_mechanisms.operational_precedent: Bryant Park Corporation model for BID-managed public facilities and concession revenue.

channeling_mechanisms.name: Dedicated Park Improvement District (PID) Pilot
channeling_mechanisms.description: Specialized assessment district tailored specifically for ongoing park funding and maintenance.
channeling_mechanisms.legislative_pathway: Collaboration with local elected leadership (Council Member Marte) to pilot a PID model at Allen Street.

channeling_mechanisms.name: Closed Data Loop for Sustained Revenue
channeling_mechanisms.sustainability_outcome: Demonstrates commercial ROI to ensure annual pledge renewal and predictable year-over-year payments to Parks.
